keynums.label: Available cash balance
keynums.value: 29.3 BINR (includes lending to LM Wind Power Blades (India) Pvt Ltd under Cash Pool arrangement)

bull_bear.body:
- The deck reports cash generation of 4.3 BINR during the quarter, leading to an available cash balance of 29.3 BINR.
- That available cash balance is footnoted as including lending to LM Wind Power Blades (India) Private Limited as part of a Cash Pool arrangement — i.e. it is not wholly free cash at the listed entity.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- The deck frames the quarter under the banner 'DISCIPLINED EXECUTION DRIVING VALUE CREATION', with order backlog of 209.3 BINR at Jun'26 versus 214.6 BINR at Mar'26 (-2.5%).
- Order backlog of 209,295 (Rs millions) is skewed to the private sector: Private 160,484 (77%), Central Utilities & PSU 44,860 (21%), State Utilities 3,951 (2%).
- Exports are a large share of new business: Q1'27 Orders of 11,370 (Rs mn) split Domestic 6,165 (54%) / Exports 5,205 (46%), while Q1'27 Sales of 18,361 split Domestic 12,817 (70%) / Exports 5,544 (30%).
- Order intake is routed materially through GE Vernova group affiliates — CTs and CVTs for GE Grid Renewable LLC (North America), 400 kV GIS for GE Grid Solutions, S.A. (Spain) and GE Grid Solutions, Middle East (Morocco).
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Renaming] The filer is GE Vernova T&D India Limited, 'Formerly known as GE T&D India Limited' (CIN L31102DL1957PLC193993), with registered office in New Delhi and corporate office at Noida.
- [Labour codes] The deck's exceptional item line is footnoted as 'Impact on account of new labour codes', with a (57) entry in Q4 FY25-26 and 636 for 12M FY25-26.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions GE Vernova T&D India Limited (formerly GE T&D India Limited) as a disciplined-execution power transmission & distribution equipment player spanning power transformers, switchgear (GIS & AIS), grid system integration and grid automation, working a 209.3 BINR order backlog that is 77% private-sector and increasingly export-linked through GE Vernova group entities.
